assumptions: W6 of PLAN-0008, built in-session by a single writer. Originally scoped for Gemini CLI, retargeted to the Antigravity CLI (agy) because Google folded Gemini CLI into Antigravity and shut Gemini CLI down 2026-06-18 (the plan text was reconciled Gemini->Antigravity in the W3 commit). agy's plugin model was researched at build (agy launched after the model cutoff): a plugin.json manifest + optional hooks.json (before-tool-call/after-model-call/loop-stop lifecycle hooks) + skills/ + agents/ + rules/ - close to Claude's, so the port is a clean re-path. The WARP-0803 enforcement fix was applied from the start (both hooks feed the guard the JSON stdin payload); the review behaviorally proved the gate blocks the unproven and allows the proven and is injection-safe, and W6 did NOT repeat the W3 fail-open. Independent adversarial review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking. TWO non-blocking notes: (1) agy's plugin.json/hooks.json schema is a fast-moving post-cutoff surface so the exact editor-hook format is unverifiable, but the guaranteed enforcement is the git pre-push hook + CI regardless (the spec states this); (2) COSMETIC - the pack spec front matter depends_on [WARP-0802] (the pattern-setter that built the manifest + drift + option B, the true dependency) while the plan's W6 work item still reads depends_on [WARP-0801] (the raw engine); validate does not enforce spec-vs-plan depends_on consistency (gate GREEN). The plan's pack-item depends_on (W3-W8: 0801 -> 0802) will be reconciled in the plan text bundled into the W7 impl commit (a plans-only commit trips policy_check).

The pack copy does not pollute the gate (packs/antigravity/specs + plans carry only TEMPLATE.md; the dash/genericity sweep covers docs/+plugin/ not packs/). check_pack_drift.py + .warp/packs.json are warp-repo tooling (no template twin).
